# NewCo

> NewCo is an engineering partner that builds with your team, operates systems together, and measures progress toward your complete engineering independence. Every engagement is planned for handover from the first week.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://projectx-gold.vercel.app/): Overview of the capability-transfer model and what we do.
- [Approach](https://projectx-gold.vercel.app/approach): The five-phase engagement model (Diagnose, Build With, Run With, Hand Over, Advise) and the scorecard that proves handover.
- [Technical Diagnostic](https://projectx-gold.vercel.app/diagnostic): A 15-day fixed-fee diagnostic covering architecture, risk, capability baseline and roadmap.
- [About](https://projectx-gold.vercel.app/about): Why NewCo exists, how the founders split responsibility, and the work we turn down.
- [Contact](https://projectx-gold.vercel.app/contact): Share your situation; every request is reviewed against our fit criteria.
